description: Capability for the main window -- core:default covers the window/webview/event/app basics every Tauri app needs, including the event:listen the voice pipeline uses to receive wake/transcript events from voice.rs (see apps/desktop/frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceListener.ts). Custom #[tauri::command]s (run_orchestrator, start_voice_listener, etc.) aren't ACL-gated and work regardless of this file -- that's why the app worked at all before this existed, and why only the event.listen() call failed.
